# railway_template_deployment (Resource)

Deployment of a Railway template into a project environment.

Deploying a template is a one-shot operation: any change to this resource replaces it, which deletes the services it created (including their volumes) and deploys the template again. The created services are tracked in `service_ids`; destroying the resource deletes them. An existing deployment can be imported; its `variables` are not recoverable, so setting them on an imported resource just records them without a redeploy.

## Common Templates

| Template | `template` | `template_id` | Key in `service_ids` |
|---|---|---|---|
| PostgreSQL | `postgres` | `b55da7dc-09be-4140-bc65-1284d15d349c` | `Postgres` |
| MySQL | `mysql` | `672d062a-37ef-4830-a46b-dee6e2191c38` | `MySQL` |
| MongoDB | `mongo` | `da83a76e-97f0-43c6-a342-e48a39293f48` | `MongoDB` |
| Redis | `redis` | `895cb7c9-8ea9-4407-b4b6-b5013a65145e` | `Redis` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "railway_template_deployment" "postgres" {
  template       = "postgres"
  project_id     = railway_project.example.id
  environment_id = railway_project.example.default_environment.id

  variables = {
    POSTGRES_DB = "app"
  }
}

output "postgres_service_id" {
  value = railway_template_deployment.postgres.service_ids["Postgres"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Identifier of the environment to deploy the template into.
- `project_id` (String) Identifier of the project to deploy the template into.
- `template` (String) Code of the template to deploy, e.g. `postgres` or `redis`.

### Optional

- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) Values for the template's variables. Keys are `KEY` (applies to every service defining it) or `<service name>.KEY`. Variables without a value fall back to the template default; required ones without a default cause an error.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the template deployment.
- `service_ids` (Map of String) Identifiers of the services created by the deployment, keyed by service name.
- `template_id` (String) Identifier of the deployed template.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax. All services in the project that were deployed from the template are adopted; `variables` cannot be recovered and stay unset.

```shell
terraform import railway_template_deployment.postgres 0bb01547-570d-4109-a5e8-138691f6a2d1:d0519b29-5d12-4857-a5dd-76fa7418336c:postgres
```
